ov: A pale, box-bodied crab of tropical and subtropical sandy beaches worldwide, with long, thick eyestalks and one claw bigger than the other. It digs deep burrows, comes out mainly at night, and is among the fastest-running invertebrates on land.
rg: Tropical and subtropical shores around the world. The Atlantic ghost crab ranges from Nova Scotia and Massachusetts to southern Brazil.
df: Clams, mole crabs, insects, other crabs, plant matter and detritus, plus the eggs and hatchlings of sea turtles.
fx: It can run at more than a metre per second.
In a 2023 mirror test, Atlantic ghost crabs seemed to recognise themselves.
